message:
Mike, I know that the life of a student is hard and money is tight, but come on.  I remember telling my mom that it was the phone company's fault when my phone was shut off while in college.  Come on Mike.  Fess up and tell the truth.  Maybe you can generate some quick sympathy cash!

Just giving you grief, man.  That has to blow.  I thought I got a bead on Ted's phone # today, but it was incorrect.  I'll keep trying.  Good luck with your paper thingy!
